_note: Batch 2 sourced audio, 2026-11-01: Act 1's second boss, title and Last Stop tracks and its missing train and boss sounds, then Wickermoor, the Crooked House and Foxwillow. Music -16 LUFS stereo with its silent ends trimmed; beds -18 LUFS and seamless (crossfaded, and every filter and limiter run round the loop); effects -14 LUFS with no silence at either end (a mono clip measured as it plays, through both speakers), true peak under -1.2 dB. All Vorbis q5, 44.1 kHz. Picked from catalogue tags, envelopes and spectrograms, never heard: notes say which ones to listen to first. Originals and licences: each pack's SOURCE.md (Kevin MacLeod's batch 2 MP3s are not kept, only their URLs).

not_needed.church_bell (engine toll): The engine's toll stays for the quest bell; Wickermoor's church gets its own bell (Alfriston, public domain) for the village's ambience.
not_needed.clock_tick: The clock chamber's bed is the tower clock's works ticking (WWS), so no separate tick one-shot.
not_needed.clock_chime_2: The Gdansk tower clock's strike was cut and dropped: its works clatter too much to level (23 LUFS after limiting).
